note: Checked 2026-11-12 after the book pull. The pre-registered sample of every raw 97-99 cent ask was not verified one by one: 3,928 of 3,946 of those asks were books wider than 3 cents or one-sided, so they are not a market sitting at 99 cents. The races below are the ones with real size. Sources are public counts, not Polymarket prices. None of these is a certified result.

mn_01.market: Democrat Yes bid 0.95 / ask 0.98, ask size 981.25. Republican Yes is 0.02 / 0.05.
mn_01.counts: Minnesota Secretary of State file ushouse.txt: Jake Johnson (DFL) 163,055, Brad Finstad (R) 162,733, write-in 391. Margin 322 or 323 votes, about 0.1 percent.
mn_01.why: Finstad requested a recount. MPR (2026-11-05) and WXOW report the State Canvassing Board meets 2026-11-19 and a recount request is open through 2026-11-23. AP had not called it. A 98 cent ask is a price on a recount, not a delayed settlement of a decided race.

ca_23.market: Democrat Yes bid 0.01 size 452 / ask 0.02. Republican Yes bid 0.98 size 432, no ask. Buying No on the Democrat at 0.99 means hitting that 0.01 bid.
ca_23.counts: Jay Obernolte (R) 106,793 (50.9 percent), Tessa Lynn Hodge (D) 102,964 (49.1 percent), about 95 percent of expected vote, updated 2026-11-12 morning. Not called.
ca_23.why: California was still counting. There is no ask on the leading Republican. The 1 cent offer on the Democrat is the remaining-count risk, and the size you can sell into is the 452-contract bid.

la_05_la_06.market: Still two-sided and not pinned at 99 cents. LA-05 Republican Yes 0.71 / 0.99. LA-06 Republican Yes 0.91 / 0.98.
la_05_la_06.counts: No candidate won a majority on November 3. Runoffs are December 12, 2026. LA-05 Pat Moore (D) vs Gabe Firment (R). LA-06 Chauna Banks (D) vs Blake Miguez (R).
la_05_la_06.why: The event end date is the November 3 primary. The race is not over. The open market is the runoff.
